title.narrative: High Impact Partnership on Climate Action (HIPCA) Fund for Nature-responsive economic development

description.narrative: The multi-donor fund "High Impact Partnership on Climate Action" (HIPCA) mobilizes and leverages donor partnerships in support of scaling up climate and nature-responsive investments on the ground in EBRD’s countries of operation. IKI funds for HIPCA’s thematic area of nature will support EBRD’s integrated approach that links investment with capacity building, technical assistance and policy engagement. IKI funds will be used to create bankable and nature-responsive investment opportunities, thus contributing to the protection and restoration of nature and biodiversity. Likewise, IKI funds will help to unlock and mobilize the private sector to act as an agent for climate and environmental action in support of Target 19 of the GBF.
